summary.text: Melissa Provenzano is a Democratic member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 79 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Provenzano was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
She received a bachelor's degree in organismic biology from Northeastern State University in 1998 and an M.Ed. in educational leadership from the University of Oklahoma in 2010.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as teacher and school administrator, and her organizational affiliations include the Cooperative Council of Oklahoma School Administration, the Oklahoma Association of Secondary School Principals, the National Association of Secondary School Principals, the Oklahoma Educators Association and the Tulsa Area Secondary Schools Principals.
She took office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Weldon Watson.

Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Administrative Rules Committee, the Appropriations and Budget Committee, the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances and the Education Oversight Committee.
Paul Hassink, a Republican, is her opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
